neighbours.label: A rhetorical question that challenges an assumption ('What's so bad about ...?', 'What's wrong with ...?', 'How hard can it be ...?'); ordinary information questions stay quiet.
fire: Why can't the form be shorter? Why shouldn't it fit on one page?
What's so terrible about taking a nap?
What's wrong with a simple salad?
How hard can it be to boil an egg?
So what's the big deal about cleaning up?
Why does it seem so hard to say sorry?
What's so special about this old chair?
quiet: When can the form be sent? We need it by noon on Monday.
What's on the menu for lunch today?
What's the price of this lamp?
How long does it take to boil an egg?
So what's the best way to the station?
Why did she go to the bank on Friday?
What's the color of this old chair?

notes: Probes: 0.38-1.20 on rhetorical questions, 0.01-0.09 on most information questions, though 'When can we simplify the plan?' reached 0.29. The '?' often carries the peak.
